    # Max-heap to keep track of the number of passes each student can take
    max_heap = []
    for i, ability in students:
        heapq.heappush(max_heap, (-c[i], i))

    days = 0

            heapq.heappop(max_heap)

        # Push the student back into the heap with updated passes
        heapq.heappush(max_heap, (passes + bug_complexity, student_index))
    
    # Check if the total passes exceed the limit
